payload.detail: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-26 (Josh, decision card 'Keep as is'): keep current behaviour; the pinned divergence stays by design. Reason, found offline 2026-09-26: this case runs through the extractiveNeedsReviewFallback branch in src/lib/rag/rag.ts, the same branch that produces the deliberate source-backed review stub (#J8SJQ9). In the adversarial harness 14 of 24 cases share the identical shape (grounded false, confidence unsupported, one review_only citation), and the pipeline cannot tell an irrelevant pointer from a relevant-but-ungenerated one, so stripping citations on unsupported abstentions would also strip the useful pointer from real stubs such as antipsychotic metabolic monitoring. The citation is already labelled review_only, and owner scope is enforced at retrieval, so other-owner content is never read. Only revisit with a relevance test at the fallback (new heuristic on a protected surface; needs a canary pair once the canary is green again). Do not delete the harness pin.
